def testSobolGeneratorMaxDraws(self):
    generator = SobolGenerator(seed=0)
    n_tunable = fixed_param_index = 3
    bounds = self._create_bounds(n_tunable=n_tunable, n_fixed=1)
    with self.assertRaises(SearchSpaceExhausted):
        generated_points, weights = generator.gen(
            n=3,
            bounds=bounds,
            linear_constraints=(
                np.array([[1, 1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 1, 0]]),
                np.array([1, 1]),
            ),
            fixed_features={fixed_param_index: 1},
            model_gen_options={"max_rs_draws": 0},
        )

Adaptive experimentation is the machine-learning guided process of iteratively exploring a (possibly infinite) parameter space in order to identify optimal configurations in a resource-efficient manner. Ax currently supports Bayesian optimization and bandit optimization as exploration strategies. Bayesian optimization in Ax is powered by [BoTorch](https://github.com/facebookexternal/botorch), a modern library for Bayesian optimization research built on PyTorch.
